name: Taiwan 2025
description: Nuclear is gone and gas leads. Midday solar is large, so when the sun sets the rest of the fleet must ramp up fast for the evening.
dataNotes: Annual peak load and installed capacity by source are official 2025 figures; battery size uses the 2025 grid-storage target. Unit counts and sizes, storage energy, DSM size and all unit parameters are illustrative. Biomass, waste and geothermal (0.8 GW) are left out. Wind is taken as about 1 GW onshore (the MOEA onshore figure) and the rest offshore.
